text: No, these sources do not contradict each other. Hansen detects 67.7 ha of tree-cover loss in 2020, but JRC shows no forest in 2020, meaning the loss occurred before the JRC baseline. The evidence supports that no *new* tree-cover loss (0.5 ha or larger) happened after 2020. The 2020 loss in Hansen aligns with JRC’s 2020 "no forest" classification, as the loss likely cleared the remaining forest before JRC’s reference year. The key point is that no additional loss occurred post-2020.
